copy.caption: A true world model is now free to download. Lightricks just released LTX-2.5 with open weights. This means you can run an AI that understands 3D physics and object persistence on your own hardware. It generates real-time video and simulates physical dynamics fast enough to use for synthetic robotic training. The catch is you still need serious VRAM. Running this locally requires a 24GB card, and fine physical details can still blur when the camera moves fast. Does open-source physical simulation change your roadmap? Tell us your thoughts below.
